name: Eco-Shop Marketing Berhad
overview: 根据所提供的公告，Eco-Shop Marketing Berhad 今年没有披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项；公告主要涉及 ESOS 新股发行、股息除权、股东大会及诉讼等公司层面事务。
overview_en: Based on the announcements provided, Eco-Shop Marketing Berhad disclosed no expansion, new business, reduction, disposal or contract wins in any business segment this year; the announcements mainly cover corporate-level matters such as ESOS share issuance, dividend ex-dates, general meetings and litigation.
